# `error-value-comparison`

<!-- rule-docs:header (generated by `zig build rule-docs`) -->
Tier: correctness · Profile: none · Default: warning · Fixes: none · Options: none

Reports comparisons between an explicitly typed error set and a concrete error
value that the set cannot contain.
<!-- /rule-docs:header -->

## Why it matters

The comparison has a constant result and therefore cannot perform the error
discrimination it appears to express.

## When it fires

The operand must resolve syntactically to an explicit `error{...}` binding.
Comparisons involving inferred or aliased error sets are left to the compiler
rather than guessed.

<!-- rule-docs:footer (generated by `zig build rule-docs`) -->
## Example

```zig
fn classify(err: error{Missing}) bool {
    return err == error.Other;
}
```
